title: Is Lumentum Stock a Buy Right Now as Marvell Considers Takeover? | LITE Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA reiterates a BUY on Lumentum, held all year and last updated on 18 May 2026, but with low conviction, at a discounted cash flow fair value of $158. The case rests on a sharp operating turnaround: revenue rose 109% last quarter and is guided up 130% next quarter, operating margin has moved from minus 255% in 2024 to 18% trailing, and debt has roughly halved to $1.65 billion against more than $2.7 billion in cash and investments, with a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 25 for growth above 100%. His bull case is that hyperscaler adoption of optical components keeps accelerating revenue and margins as artificial-intelligence data-centre spending stays strong. His bear case is that earnings growth plateaus around 2029-2030 as AI spending normalises, with near-term macro and AI-sentiment headwinds after a 143% run in 2026. The market price was garbled in the auto-captions, reading $915, which is inconsistent with his undervalued verdict. Despite the title, the captions do not discuss a Marvell takeover of Lumentum. No other ticker receives a call.
